title: Consistent hash ring
summary: Build a consistent hash ring with virtual nodes so that adding or removing a node moves only about 1/N of the keys.

complexity.time: O(N·V) per vnode inserted into a sorted array

complexity.space: O(N·V) for N nodes, V vnodes each

hints: Nodes and keys live on the same circle of 2^32 positions. A key belongs to the first node position at or after its own, going clockwise.
Keep one sorted list of (position, node) points, with V points per node from the labels node#0 … node#(V−1). Lookups are then a binary search, not a scan.

get_node: i = lower_bound(positions, hash32(key)); if i equals the length, use 0 (wraparound). add_node inserts V points in order and ignores a node it already has; remove_node filters that node's points out.
